visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a brown zip-up hoodie and a tan ushanka-style hat, sits in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a red gift bag with a circus-themed 'STEAMCREAM' illustration toward the camera, her facial expression animated and smiling. (2) She transitions to opening a cardboard mailing box, revealing two decorative metal tins inside. She picks up a red tin featuring Snoopy and shows it closely to the lens, her hands steady as she points out details. (3) The scene shifts to her applying a white cream from the tin onto the back of her hand, rubbing it in circular motions; the skin reflects the bright studio lighting with a noticeable sheen. (4) She holds several white boxes and tubes of a bubble mask product, then applies a white foam to her hand, demonstrating its texture as it expands slightly. (5) She unboxes a yellow 'Hapa Kristin' gift box containing contact lens packs and a cartoon-styled eye mask, holding each item up individually to show the branding. (6) A large cardboard shipping box is opened, and she pulls out a high volume of individually wrapped face masks with varied patterns like plaid, floral, and holiday themes, piling them up. (7) She holds up a specific large green mask package while a small circular inset photo of a man in a hat appears briefly on the screen. (8) She finishes by making a heart shape with her hands, surrounded by digital flower and heart overlays, smiling broadly as she speaks to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright, high-pitched 'pop' sound signals the start, followed by an upbeat acoustic guitar track with a light percussive beat. A female voice speaks with high energy and a cheerful tone, welcoming the audience. (2) Mid-frequency rustling of paper and cardboard is audible as she begins unboxing the first item. The narrator's speech is fast-paced with frequent rising intonations. (3) A 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual cut. The female voice maintains a high arousal level while describing the 'SteamCream' texture. (4) Distinct 'thud' and 'crinkle' sounds occur as she pours out a large quantity of face masks. She lets out a short, high-pitched laugh, followed by exaggerated 'wow' sounds. (5) Cartoon-style 'ding' and 'sparkle' sound effects are peppered throughout the middle section during product highlights. The background music remains consistent in tempo and volume. (6) The vocal delivery becomes slightly more rhythmic as she lists different mask sizes. The guitar BGM continues until a final melodic flourish at the end, concluding with a warm 'thank you' from the narrator.
